character.description: friendly veteran space captain, upper-body bust portrait, gray-white wavy hair and mustache, navy and silver jacket

normal.action: calm gentle smile, then a soft slow blink; same bust pose, head and shoulders stay still, only the eyelids change

smile.action: big warm happy smile with eyes crinkled, slight pleased head tilt in frame 2

serious.action: serious focused expression, mouth closed and straight, brows lowered; frame 2 gives a small slow nod

surprised.action: surprised expression, eyebrows raised, eyes wide, mouth open in an O; frame 2 is slightly more astonished

style: crisp hand-painted HD 2D game illustration, clean dark outlines, soft cel shading, cartoon-leaning; same character, same jacket, same bust framing in every frame
